# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 19 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 19:1 — saw in his spirit vs. in the spirit

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "saw in his spirit the wickedness" | Literal en tō pneumati autou |
| LOGOS | "in his spirit he saw the wickedness" | Transposed for English flow |
| PNEUMA | "in his spirit he saw the evil scheme" | Adds 'scheme' for interpretive clarity |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** LOGOS is adopted. The transposition improves English flow without altering meaning. PNEUMA's 'scheme' is interpretive. Adopted LOGOS.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 19:3 — repay evil with evil

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "repay evil with evil" | Literal anti kakou kakon apodounai |
| LOGOS | "repay evil with evil" | Same |
| PNEUMA | "repay evil with evil" | Same |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** All three translators agree. No divergence logged — included here as a note that this proverbial form is preserved consistently.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of All.

---
